name: Samurai Dragon Samurai
body:
The dragon samurai devotes themselves to a dragon or dragon clan. In exchange for their fealty, they gain draconic powers.

Breath Weapon (Su)

Beginning with 1st level, as a standard action, a dragon samurai can let out a draconic breath weapon in a 15-foot cone or 30-foot line, chosen when the ability is gained. The damage type dealt by this breath weapon is chosen, and can’t later be changed, from one of the following: acid, cold, electricity, or fire. The damage of this breath weapon is 1d8 per 2 samurai class levels the dragon samurai possesses. A Reflex save DC (10 +1/2 the dragon samurai’s class level + their Constitution modifier) halves the damage taken. This ability is usable a number of times per day equal to their Con modifier.

At 10th level, the range for the breath weapon increases to 30 feet for a cone or 60 feet for a line.

This ability replaces challenge.

Draconic Resistance (Ex)

At 1st level, a dragon samurai gains resistance to the damage type chosen with their breath weapon. This resistance starts with 5, but increases by 5 at 5th level and every 5 levels thereafter, culminating with immunity at 20th level.

This ability replaces mount.

Dragon Hearted (Ex)

At 4th level, a dragon samurai is immune to the frightful presence exuded by dragons and gains a +4 bonus to Charisma-based skill checks regarding dragons. This ability replaces mounted archer.

Elemental Weapon (Su)

At 12th level, a dragon samurai can expend a use of their breath weapon through a melee weapon attack as a swift action. They must declare the use of the ability before making the attack and on a hit, they deal their breath weapon damage to the target of the melee attack in addition to the normal damage dealt by the attack. This ability replaces demanding challenge.
